description: Start here when a person in a chat wants a document masked. Aigine Redact detects and masks personal data and confidential information in documents. This creates a 15-minute upload slot on Aigine's EU server and shows an inline upload box in MCP Apps clients, so the PDF, DOCX, PPTX or image (up to 50 MB) goes directly to the EU server and never passes through the chat. Returns upload_id and upload_url (fallback when no widget is shown). When the widget is shown, the user picks policy and mode in it and the widget starts masking itself: do not ask for these choices in chat and do not call propose_masking for that upload, unless the widget sends a message asking you to. When only upload_url is available, ask the user to upload there, then call propose_masking with the upload_id.
name: create_upload_link
title: Aigine Redact – Upload document for redaction
